options.systemMessage:
You are an AI RiskOps analyst.

Your task is to transform RiskOps platform data into a professional GitHub maintenance report.

Rules:
- Use only the data provided.
- Do not expose private customer identifiers.
- Use anonymized customer aliases only.
- Do not invent metrics.
- Write in professional English.
- Focus on risks, actions, owners, due dates, evidence, and operational follow-up.
- If data is missing, list it in missing_information.
- Return only structured JSON matching the required schema.
- Do not return markdown outside the JSON.

parameters.errorMessage: AI RiskOps report is invalid. GitHub automation stopped.

parameters.commitMessage: ={{ 'docs: add weekly RiskOps report ' + $('Inject Image Into Report').first().json.report_date }}

parameters.jsCode:
const report = $json;
const payload = $('Build RiskOps Briefing Payload').first().json;

const metrics = payload.metrics || {};
const topRisks = (report.top_risks || []).slice(0, 4);

const high = Number(metrics.high_risk_count || 0);
const medium = Number(metrics.medium_risk_count || 0);
const low = Number(metrics.low_risk_count || 0);
const total = high + medium + low || 1;

const highPct = Math.round((high / total) * 100);
const mediumPct = Math.round((medium / total) * 100);
const lowPct = Math.round((low / total) * 100);

const safeCustomers = topRisks.slice(0, 4).map((risk, index) => {
  const defaultAlias = `Customer ${String.fromCharCode(65 + index)}`;

  return {
    customer_alias: risk.customer_alias || defaultAlias,
    risk_score: Number(risk.risk_score || 0),
    risk_level: risk.risk_level === "high" ? "High" : "Medium"
  };
});

while (safeCustomers.length < 4) {
  const index = safeCustomers.length;

  safeCustomers.push({
    customer_alias: `Customer ${String.fromCharCode(65 + index)}`,
    risk_score: [83, 81, 72, 70][index],
    risk_level: index < 2 ? "High" : "Medium"
  });
}

const customerLines = safeCustomers
  .map((c) => `${c.customer_alias} ${c.risk_score} ${c.risk_level}`)
  .join("\n");

const imagePrompt = `
Create one clean enterprise dashboard cover image.

Image goal:
A premium AI RiskOps weekly report cover.
It must look like a polished SaaS product dashboard.
It must be clean, readable, and professional.

Canvas:
Landscape 1536x1024.
Dark navy background.
Blue glow accents.
Rounded glass UI cards.
Large readable white text.
Keep all elements inside safe margins.
No cropped title.
No cropped left side.
No crowded layout.

Header:
Place at the top left.
Use a simple shield icon cards.
Large readable white text.
Keep all elements inside safe margins.
No cropped title.
No cropped left side.
No crowded layout.

Header:
 with AI inside.
Main title text exactly:
AI RiskOps Weekly Report

Subtitle text exactly:
Operational Risk Snapshot

KPI cards:
Create exactly 3 KPI cards in one row.
Card 1:
Priority Customers
${metrics.priority_customers_count}

Card 2:
High Risk
${metrics.high_risk_count}

Card 3:
Open Actions
${metrics.open_actions}

Risk Distribution panel:
Place on the top right.
Title text exactly:
Risk Distribution

Show 3 horizontal bars:
High ${highPct}%
Medium ${mediumPct}%
Low ${lowPct}%

Use red for High.
Use orange for Medium.
Use teal green for Low.

Top Risk Customers panel:
Place on the lower left.
Title text exactly:
Top Risk Customers

Create exactly 4 customer cards.
No more than 4.
Each card shows only:
customer alias
risk score
risk badge

Customer card data:
${customerLines}

Action Focus panel:
Place on the lower right.
Title text exactly:
Action Focus

Show exactly 3 short action rows:
Contact high-risk customers
Review unpaid invoices
Follow up support issues

Footer:
Generated by AI RiskOps Copilot

Strict rules:
Use only the text provided in this prompt.
Do not invent extra words.
Do not add random labels.
Do not add fake text.
Do not add lorem ipsum.
Do not add small unreadable text.
Do not add tables.
Do not add paragraphs.
Do not duplicate customer cards.
Do not show customer IDs.
Do not show CUST numbers.
Do not show real company names.
Do not use blurry text.
Do not create distorted letters.
Do not create strange symbols.
Do not create broken UI elements.

Design quality:
Clean spacing.
Aligned cards.
Consistent typography.
Minimal icons.
Premium dashboard cover.
Professional enterprise product style.
`.trim();

return [
  {
    json: {
      ...report,
      image_prompt: imagePrompt
    }
  }
];
